notes.title: Steam Award Nominations - A Labor of Love
notes.content:
Can one super-powered, amnesiac kitten uncover the mysteries of a top-secret villainous organization? In the Definitive Edition of Bright Paw, Theo the cat navigates dangerous and incredible locations, using strategy and skill to unravel the mystery of his past. With over 100 new levels, as well as new rewards and hidden collectibles added in the Definitive Edition, Bright Paw truly has been a labor of love.

[previewyoutube=YQU9OMH8gag;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you've all been enjoying the mystery, the puzzles, and of course Theo the cat! We'd be honored to be nominated for Labor of Love in this year's Steam Awards.

notes.title: Bright Paw: Definitive Edition Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YQU9OMH8gag;full][/previewyoutube]
We are happy to launch a major update for Bright Paw called the Definitive Edition! What does this major update include you say? 

Definitive Edition includes:
[list]
[*] An additional 101 levels of endgame content
[*]New rewards in the form of player skins and card styles
[*]New seasonal content to unlock
[*]Beautiful, stylized visuals and an atmospheric soundtrack
[*]Expanded accessibility options
[/list]

I have a "feline" you won't wanna miss this...

notes.title: Bright Paw Is Now 50% Off!
notes.content:
Well the cat is out of the bag this Halloween on Steam because we're putting Bright Paw on sale for a limited time. Get 50% off now until November 1st and experience an adorable but mysterious story behind the death of your owners. How did this happen? Who murdered them? Why does the narrator have a British accent? Find out when you play Bright Paw for a low low low price.

Happy Halloween everyone!
